# Requirements Analysis — Bugfix: `useRouteRef` in App Root Elements Crashes During Startup

- **Run ID**: `20261104-120000-bugfix-useroutref-startup`
- **Mode**: brownfield
- **Intent**: bugfix

---

## Reproduce & Diagnose

### Reproduce
- **Symptom**: In the new frontend system, an app root element attached to `app/root.elements` (such as a banner) that calls `useRouteRef` while the app is starting up (during the bootstrap phase of `prepareSpecializedApp`) crashes by throwing `Error: No path for <routeRef>` when the target route ref's own path is known in the partial tree but an ancestor route ref's path is not yet registered. Furthermore, once the crash is prevented (or when the target route ref itself is deferred until finalization), the startup-rendered `app/root.elements` component never updates to receive the resolved route function after app finalization.
- **Reproducing test (must fail on current code)**: A new integration test in `packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/createSpecializedApp.test.tsx` (under `describe('prepareSpecializedApp', ...)`) that renders a prepared app whose `app/root.elements` extension (e.g., a banner component) calls `useRouteRef` on a route ref that cannot be resolved during bootstrap (such as when an ancestor route path or target route is in a deferred subtree) and only becomes resolvable upon finalization. On the current code, rendering during startup either throws `No path for ...` or fails to resolve the link after finalization.

### Diagnose (Verified Against Codebase)
1. **Unregistered ancestor path throws in `resolveBasePath` (`packages/frontend-app-api/src/routing/RouteResolver.ts`)**:
   - **Confirmed**: During bootstrap, `createBootstrapApp` (`packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/treeLifecycle.tsx`, lines 48–101) calls `instantiateAndInitializePhaseTree` (`packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/phaseApis.tsx`, lines 241–279) with `stopAtAttachment: ({ node, input }) => isSessionBoundaryAttachment(node, input)` (stopping at

I have completed the Phase 1 requirements analysis and written [requirements.md](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/.sdlc/runs/20261104-120000-bugfix-useroutref-startup/requirements.md) based on [intent_brief.md](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/.sdlc/runs/20261104-120000-bugfix-useroutref-startup/intent_brief.md) and verification of the codebase:

- **Reproduce & Diagnose**:
  - Verified in [`resolveBasePath`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/routing/RouteResolver.ts#L92-L164) ([RouteResolver.ts](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/routing/RouteResolver.ts#L150-L161)) that when a target route ref's own path is registered in `routePaths` during bootstrap, but an ancestor route ref in `refDiffList` does not yet have a path in `routePaths`, line 153 throws `new Error(\`No path for \${ref}\`)` instead of returning `undefined`.
  - Verified in [`RouteResolutionApiProxy`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/phaseApis.tsx#L113-L165) and [`instantiateAndInitializePhaseTree`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/phaseApis.tsx#L241-L279) that the proxy is re-initialized in place during [`finalizeFromSessionState`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/prepareSpecializedApp.tsx#L636-L714) while `app/root.elements` instances are preserved by [`clearFinalizationBoundaryInstances`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/treeLifecycle.tsx#L171-L198). Because [`useRouteRef`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.tsx#L36-L51) memoizes on `[routeResolutionApi, routeRef, pathname]`, startup-rendered elements never re-resolve once the app is finalized.
